core.headline: Brook Hall, Wadhurst Road, near Frant, East Sussex
core.listing:
Brook Hall is a detached Edwardian country house of 1908 with five bedrooms, set in approximately 4.5 acres near Frant, East Sussex. The property stands within the High Weald National Landscape and is approached by a gated drive.

The house is of brick with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. The principal reception rooms comprise a drawing room measuring 7.10m x 5.20m (23'4" x 17'1") and a dining room measuring 5.40m x 4.60m (17'9" x 15'1"). There are four reception rooms in total.

The kitchen/breakfast room measures 8.20m x 4.90m (26'11" x 16'1").

The principal bedroom measures 5.60m x 4.80m (18'4" x 15'9"). There are five bedrooms and four bathrooms.

The grounds include gardens, a terrace and a heated outdoor pool served by an air source heat pump. A three-acre paddock forms part of the land. An oak-framed triple cart lodge was built in 2025, with a one-bedroom annexe above.

Frant station is approximately 2 miles distant, with services to London Bridge in approximately 1 hour. Royal Tunbridge Wells is approximately 4 miles away.

The property is offered at a guide price of £2,100,000 and is freehold. Council Tax Band H (Wealden District Council). EPC rating E. Construction: Standard – Brick with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (not metered). Sewerage: Treatment plant. Heating: Oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: Limited indoors; good outdoor coverage. Parking: Gated drive with parking for several cars; triple cart lodge. The property is within the High Weald National Landscape. A public footpath crosses the southern edge of the paddock. Planning permission was granted in 2025 for the cart lodge with annexe above (built). Council tax banding of the annexe has not been confirmed.
core.summary: An Edwardian country house of 1908 in approximately 4.5 acres including a three-acre paddock, with heated outdoor pool and oak-framed cart lodge with annexe, within the High Weald National Landscape near Frant.
